title: Pack hooks: question + PROJECT.md-field collectors with isolation assert (Phase D-2)
description: Build the two pure collectors that realize the Option C (hybrid) hook over the active-pack set from TASK-126. New module src/pack-hooks.js: (1) collectPackQuestions(activePacks, coreQuestionIds) concatenates each active pack module's exported `questions` (design-power's export = DESIGN_PROFILE_QUESTIONS from src/design-profile.js) onto the core question list, guarding against question-id collisions; (2) applyProjectMdContributions(activePacks, answers) runs each pack module's derive export (design-power's = deriveProfileFields), asserts every returned key is a member of that pack's declared descriptor.project_md_contribution (the isolation envelope), and merges the result into answers. Core stays the ONLY caller of runQuestionnaire/writeProjectMd; src/question-library.js stays byte-unpatched. No bin/init.js wiring here (that is Phase D-3). Engine constraints to respect (src/question-engine.js): globally-unique ids (engine throws on dupes), forward-only `when(answers)` (no lookahead), types string|number|enum|multi. Grounds: docs/design/addon-packs.md §5/§8, the human-approved Option C decision.
acceptance_criteria: collectPackQuestions appends active-pack questions AFTER the core questions and returns a combined list whose forward-only `when` predicates remain valid (the appended block references only ids within the same block or earlier). A question id that collides with a core id (or another pack's id) throws a pack-attributed error naming the offending id; a table-driven test proves both the happy append and the collision throw.

applyProjectMdContributions runs each active pack's derive fn and merges its output (for design-power: {tier, perfil_proyecto}) into answers; a derived key NOT in that pack's descriptor.project_md_contribution throws a pack-attributed isolation error and merges NOTHING for that pack (all-or-nothing). Non-vacuous: a stub pack whose derive emits an out-of-envelope key asserts the throw fires.

With zero active packs BOTH collectors are no-ops: collectPackQuestions returns the core list unchanged and applyProjectMdContributions returns answers unchanged (deep-equal), proving injection is strictly additive and off-by-default.

Both collectors are pure/deterministic (no I/O) and are exercised against the REAL DESIGN_PROFILE_QUESTIONS + deriveProfileFields (not only stubs), so the design-power pack's actual contributions are covered.
